senses.gloss: a reasoner (opp. to learned, v. גְּמַר II).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:8">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵃ</cite> <he>הדין ס׳ דלא יליף וכ׳</he> that reasoner who has neither studied nor attended scholars.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:2:6">Y. Kidd. III, 63ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>דחגיי אינשא ס׳ הוא</he> (not <cite ref="N01301"><he>אינשי</he></cite>) for Ḥ. is a fanciful man (whose traditions cannot be relied upon).
